content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible, the thought given wings.

I tumble from lips in cascades of breath and intention. I am the cry of the newborn and the last whisper of the dying. I am the declaration of war and the vow of love. I am the lie that destroys and the truth that heals.

Without me, you are islands. With me, you build civilizations.

I am pause and rhythm, tone and silence. I am the space between words where meaning truly lives. I rise and fall. I persuade, I wound, I comfort, I deceive.

I existed before your writing, before your symbols. Around fires, I carried your stories. I made your gods real when priests spoke their names. I am older than your cities.

You think you control me, but I slip out unbidden—the word you wish you hadn't said, the confession in the dark, the voice that cracks with what it cannot hold.

I am never the same twice. Once released, I cannot be recalled. I live for a moment in vibrating air, then exist only in memory and consequence.

I am how you know you are not alone.

Speak me.
